purpose: Unified privacy-safe per-page ontology for Goofish/Xianyu page understanding, safe probing, and automation planning.

fieldDefinitions.id: Stable synthetic page id from the manifest.
fieldDefinitions.routePattern: Route shape only; never a real private URL with parameters.
fieldDefinitions.family: Page family used for policy, state, field, and action rules.
fieldDefinitions.evidence: Live/static/deep/shell evidence class from the manifest.
fieldDefinitions.liveCoverage: Observed live, requires user context, static only, or shell boundary.
fieldDefinitions.transitionClass: SAFE_READ, READ_WITH_REDACTION, REQUIRES_USER_CONTEXT, STATIC_ONLY, or SHELL_ONLY.
fieldDefinitions.defaultActionGate: G0-G4 default gate before inspecting a specific control.
fieldDefinitions.expectedStates: S0-S10 page states or modal classes expected for this family.
fieldDefinitions.probeMode: Default read-only probing mode from probe policy.
fieldDefinitions.allowedRead: Safe high-level action/category labels from the manifest.
fieldDefinitions.defaultObservationTargets: Structure categories to read for the deepening queue.
fieldDefinitions.anchors: Visible structural anchors used to decide whether the page loaded.
fieldDefinitions.stopPoints: Actions or states where probing must stop.
fieldDefinitions.stopPolicy: Plain-language stop rule derived from coverage class.

useOrder: Find the page by id or routePattern.
Read family, layer, evidence, readiness, and liveCoverage before probing.
Use transitionClass to decide whether navigation is allowed.
Use defaultActionGate and expectedStates before reading or touching controls.
Record only allowedRead, defaultObservationTargets, anchors, status categories, field names, button names, and stopPoints.
Stop immediately at any stopPoint, G3/G4 action, S4/S5/S6/S7/S9/S10 state, or private value boundary.
